entries.unchanged_closure_criteria: Trace the cleanup helper and publish reference-state/outcome tables and cancellation/completion race fixtures.
entries.review: Retained handler 10013040 and cleanup-helper 1000e760 code, a reference-state/outcome table, the earlier queued/pending/absent/zero/unknown/nonowner cases and ten new native cases satisfy the unchanged criterion. A complete multi-chunk baseline, three immediate and three partial-read cancellations establish exact delivered prefixes and observed incoming-request/data overlap. Packet timing is separated from buffered application reads after ACK. Nonowner cleanup allows continued full delivery; owner/duplicate cleanup ACKs and removed-reference rejection are verified. A pending upload survives 214, consistent with the helper collection search. Native HFS+ DATA/MACR bytes match seeds after all cases. Finite races do not establish universal delivery counts, deadlines, rollback or folder/banner stream conformance.
